No production code under src/pcae/ was modified by Phase 149O.7 -- verification-only, doc + new independent test file only. Wave 1 (repository identity), Wave 2 (trust-store authority), Wave 3 (canonicalization), Wave 4 (verification-state vocabulary/verify_hatp_proof), Wave 5 (provider/crypto semantics), Wave 6 (rollback_approval_evidence.py RAE/HATP binding) semantics all independently reconfirmed unchanged since 149O.5 and 149O.6 (zero diff on their owning files across both baselines, independently re-run via git diff, not cited from the prior report). No real Class-B provisioning occurred during this verification; no host-mutation command pattern (useradd/dscl/sudoers/chmod/chown/setfacl/subprocess.run|Popen|call) found anywhere in the two Wave-7-touched production files, independently grepped. No direct HATP-status-to-PB-ALLOW mapping exists (independently read every PolicyRule in permission_broker_foundation.py). Permission Broker remains the sole permission-decision engine; whether it is an enforced execution gate is reported separately and honestly as advisory/not-yet-enforced, and independently shown to be structurally forced by PB's own pre-existing, system-wide simulation_only=True/POL-005 (ExecutionDisabledRule) architecture (Phase 108A) -- not a Wave-7-specific gap. HATP operational readiness remains distinct from PCAE Runtime Execution capability; runtime remains Observed/observe/unavailable, confirmed before and after this phase via pcae runtime inspect. F-2 (no hatp_provider/hatp_trust_store/approval_present injection parameter on resolve_ag3_gated_rollback_authority/resolve_ag5_gated_rollback_authority) independently re-confirmed via inspect.signature, not copied from the 149O.6 suite. AG3/AG5 default invocation (no hatp_evidence_id) independently confirmed to never import or call hatp_ag_authority -- the real, reachable CLI dispatch path (pcae remote rollback approve/execute) is governed exclusively by the pre-existing rollback_approval_state/PER-status precondition, which never reads the gated HATP fact; approve_rollback itself is a bare on-disk state-mutation function with no RAE/HATP/PB involvement. No CLI/signing-ceremony surface exists anywhere in src/pcae/commands/ (independently grepped, zero hits for hatp_evidence_id/HumanApprovalProvenanceProof/request_signature). B-149O-1..4 independently adjudicated INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT HATP-GATED AUTHORITY BOUNDARY -- SYSTEM EXECUTION CLOSURE DEFERRED (one notch more conservative than 149O.6's own REPAIRED AT SYSTEM IMPLEMENTATION LEVEL, since the real CLI dispatch path is confirmed to never reach the gated adapter at all) -- not OPEN, since every reproduced attack against the gated function's own logic is correctly blocked, and not CLOSED, since the real dispatch/execution boundary is not forced through HATP. summary: Phase 149O.7 -- HATP Class-B Deployment / Activation Independent Verification: verification-only adversarial re-verification of Phase 149O.6 (Wave 7); no production code modified. Independently reconstructed the exact 3-file Wave-7 production diff (agent.py, hatp_ag_authority.py (new), human_approval_trusted_provenance.py; UNRELATED=0, confirmed via git diff rather than cited). Independently re-derived HATP-REQ-105/106/108/109/115 from contract text directly and concluded nothing in HATP-001's normative text requires AG3/AG5's pre-existing dispatch precondition to be replaced or gated by HATP as part of Wave-7 closure -- the contract requires a correctly-derived, non-forgeable approval_present fact to exist and be PB-consulted when HATP evidence is presented (delivered), and separately anticipates (HATP-REQ-115) that real deployment/CLI wiring is a distinct, later-arriving fact. Independently re-derived the 7-term Class-B readiness conjunction from source (not the docstring); re-confirmed no assert-based security, no environment-override hook, no host-mutation command, and the real deployment mechanically NOT_READY/operational=False. Independently re-confirmed F-2 closure via inspect.signature on both adapter functions (no hatp_provider/hatp_trust_store/approval_present parameter) and by tracing _resolve_gated_approval's actual dependency-resolution call sites. Traced execute_rollback/build_rollback_execution's actual dispatch preconditions (rollback_approval_state=='approved' for AG3 -- a bare on-disk string set by the ungated approve_rollback function, directly exposed as 'pcae remote rollback approve'; PER status/divergence for AG5) and confirmed neither reads the new hatp_authority field: the gated HATP path is additive-only, attached to the return value after dispatch, never itself gating the real git-revert/file-restore mutation -- confirmed by source trace, not by trusting 149O.6's report. Independently grepped src/pcae/commands/ and confirmed zero references to hatp_evidence_id/HumanApprovalProvenanceProof/request_signature anywhere -- no CLI/signing-ceremony surface exists. Traced Permission Broker's hardcoded simulation_only=True (on every gated-adapter PB request) and POL-005 (ExecutionDisabledRule, unconditional DENY for any real non-simulation request under the system-wide execution_unavailable/no-COMP-002 architecture, Phase 108A) to independently establish that PB's advisory posture here is structurally forced by PB's own pre-existing, system-wide architecture, not a Wave-7-specific gap -- the single most decisive fact this phase adds beyond 149O.6's own report. Reclassification-checked Wave-5 findings B-149O.3-1/-3/-8: independently traced that Fido2HardwareProvider.capabilities() (the only method Wave-7's provider_attestation_trusted term calls) returns a hardcoded literal and never references the credential registry those findings concern (remain non-blocking); independently confirmed verify_hatp_proof still wraps provider.verify() in a fail-closed except-Exception umbrella (B-149O.3-8 cannot propagate an unhandled exception through the gated path). Re-ran the 149O.6 suite's own historical-attack-reproduction tests through the real resolve_ag3_gated_rollback_authority entry point and confirmed all four B-149O-1..4 attacks still blocked; combined with the dispatch-trace finding, adjudicated B-149O-1..4 as INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT HATP-GATED AUTHORITY BOUNDARY -- SYSTEM EXECUTION CLOSURE DEFERRED (one notch more conservative than 149O.6's own 'system implementation level', since real CLI dispatch never reaches the gated path at all; not OPEN, since no exploitable path into the gated function's own logic was found). Diagnosed and root-caused (to the exact chgr_envelope.py/coordinator.py line numbers) a pre-existing, unrelated Python-3.9 datetime.fromisoformat incompatibility that otherwise blocks most RAE/HATP fixture-chain test execution in this sandbox; confirmed pre-existing via the 149O.5 baseline; worked around with a process-local, test-only, non-production monkeypatch to independently re-execute the affected suites, reproducing 149O.6's own regression claims exactly (149O.6 suite 26/26, Wave 4 136/136, Wave 6 51 passed + 1 pre-existing failure, Wave 6.5 47/47, RAE-rollback sweep 511 passed + 4 pre-existing unrelated failures, Fast Green 4652 passed/1 skipped/0 failed). Independently re-confirmed 149O.5's own carried, non-blocking finding F-3 (test_rae_permission_broker_agent_still_byte_unchanged_since_freeze) is still open, now additionally compounded by Wave 7's own agent.py change -- not a new finding; corrected an earlier draft of the verification document that had mischaracterized it as newly discovered. New independent suite tests/test_phase_149o_7_hatp_class_b_activation_independent_verification.py: 21 passed, freshly authored (no fixture imports from the 149O.6 suite for its own assertions). No Blocking finding independently confirmed. Overall verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING / DEFERRED FINDINGS -- HATP WAVE 7 CLASS-B DEPLOYMENT / ACTIVATION CONFORMS. HATP-001 v1.0 confirmed byte-unchanged. No production code modified by this phase. HATP production remains NOT READY on this deployment. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable, confirmed before and after. Full detail in docs/PHASE_149O_7_HATP_CLASS_B_DEPLOYMENT_ACTIVATION_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md. Recommended next phase: 149O.8, HATP AG3/AG5 Production Consumption + Signing-Ceremony Architecture.
